Order 
Applicant has filed this first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973.

He is in jail since 10.12.2022 in connection with Crime No.196/19 registered at P.S. - Amjhera,
District Dhar (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Section 363, 366-A, 376,
376(2)(n), 376(D), 368 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

As per the prosecution story, on 5.4.2019 father of the prosecutrix lodged a missing person report at P.S. Amjhera, District Dhar by stating that his minor daughter/prosecutrix is missing from home since 4.4.2019.

Thereafter, during the investigation prosecutrix was recovered and it has been gathered that present applicant alongwith co-accused Dilip abducted the prosecutrix and co- accused committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
Accordingly offence has been registered.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant contended that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this matter.
He is in custody since 10.12.2022.
He is not the main accused who has committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
Limited allegation levelled against him is for helping the co-accused in abducting the prosecutrix.

Earlier applicant was enlarged on bail vide order dated 13.12.2019 passed by the trial Court, but later on he could not appear before the trial Court on the scheduled date, therefore, arrest warrant was issued and he has been taken into custody, but final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
Hence, he prays that applicant be released on bail.
Per-contra, learned PL for respondent/State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.
Perused the case diary as well as the impugned order of the court below.

Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, nature and gravity of allegation as also taking note of the fact that present applicant is not the main accused who has committed rape upon the prosecutrix, only limited allegation has been levelled against him, earlier applicant was enlarged on bail by the order of the trial Court Signature

Notand this is a case of bail jump, applicant has suffered jail incarceration for a Verified Signed by: TRILOK SINGH SAVNER period of almost 2 months for his default of non appearance before the trial Signing time: 21-Feb-23 10:56:24 AM Court and that final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/-
with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

He shall abide by the conditions enumerated u/S.
437(3) Cr.P.C.
C.C. as per rules.
(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE trilok Mangal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113447954/
